build_nest_cpp_extension: build the nest C++ extension module using pybind11 and C++17 standard
install_nest_package: install the nest package with pip using CXX=c++ pip install . -vv
configure_get_pybind_include: configure the get_pybind_include helper class to resolve pybind11 include paths lazily
customize_build_ext_compiler: customize the BuildExt class to add platform-specific compiler flags for unix and msvc
review_setup_py: review the setup.py to understand the nest package build configuration and dependencies
